components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for submissions and confirmed workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0284C7; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; font: 600 12px/1.35 Figtree, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0369A1; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(14,165,233,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Destructive action that needs an explicit visual warning.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; font: 600 12px/1.35 Figtree, sans-serif; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #B91C1C; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(220,38,38,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact field for filters, forms, and employee data entry.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #0F172A; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0284C7; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(14,165,233,.14); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White information container on the neutral application canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.08); transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 16px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #475569; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.12); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected dashboard destination in the persistent sidebar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #BAE6FD; color: #0369A1; text-decoration: none; font: 600 13px/1.35 Figtree, sans-serif; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #E0F2FE; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(14,165,233,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
SDM Handal should feel like a dependable clinical operations desk: calm enough for sensitive employee work, exact enough for payroll and attendance decisions, and structured enough to make approvals legible. The visual system uses a clean cyan-blue medical palette against pale neutral surfaces, with dark slate text and restrained elevation so information remains the dominant signal.

The interface is operational rather than decorative. Rounded surfaces, compact data typography, clear status color, and responsive navigation create a consistent environment across employee self-service and HRD/IT administration. The tone is precise and clinical: confident through consistency, not through visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: Cyan-blue accents on pale, quiet surfaces.
Figtree for UI hierarchy and Noto Sans for longer explanatory copy.
Rounded, tactile controls with visible hover and focus states.
Dense but breathable dashboard layouts that prioritize scanability.

rules.name: The Clinical Signal Rule
rules.body: Use cyan to clarify action or state; do not flood neutral content with accent color.

rules.name: The Data-First Rule
rules.body: Keep labels compact and values easy to scan; reserve display scale for page context, not every card.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Depth should explain hierarchy or interaction state, never decorate an otherwise flat dashboard.

dos: Do use cyan-blue as a purposeful action and state signal.
Do preserve the Figtree/Noto Sans pairing and the compact data hierarchy.
Do provide visible hover, focus, disabled, and error states for interactive controls.
Do use Lucide or equivalent SVG icons with consistent sizing instead of text glyphs.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast for body copy and important statuses.
donts: Don't introduce AI-slop purple, blue, or pink gradients.
Don't use emojis as structural navigation icons.
Don't mix sharp corners and ultra-round shapes within the same view.
Don't mix raw hex and semantic primary tokens for the same role in one component.
Don't make interactive surfaces visually static or remove their focus treatment.
